Hannah Lee: quick flag after today's staging push — some dark-mode export issues surfaced when QA printed graphs.
Omar Haddad: thanks, what broke?
Hannah Lee: legend swatches are tiny and low-alpha; when exported to PPT/PDF they almost vanish. Also inline code pills in the Audit logs lose separation from rows.
Vi Tran: can you paste the vars?
Hannah Lee: sure: `--legend-swatch-alpha: 0.12`, swatch 10x10, `--code-pill-bg: #0f1418`, `--code-pill-fg: #9ba7b2`. Code pills read ~3.0:1 on common monitors.
Omar Haddad: two quick fixes: bump legend alpha to 0.22 + size 12x12 + 1px outline `rgba(255,255,255,0.06)`. For pills either lighten fg to `#dbeeff` or add inset 1px border.
Vi Tran: agree. For charts, QA also reported heatmap bucket colors collapse in grayscale and to deuteranopes. We should use discrete bins with a colorblind-safe palette and add hatch patterns when export=print.
Hannah Lee: I like discrete bins + hatch for print. Also request a small toggle under Settings: "Export-friendly graphics" (defaults off).
ContrastBot: scan-report v4.0: issues detected: legend contrast fail (print), inline-code contrast fail (WCAG 2.1 AA), heatmap indistinct for deuteranopia. Recommendations: swatch alpha >=0.2, legend text >=4.5:1, adopt colorblind palette (e.g., #4AA3FF, #FF9F5A, #2AB9A3) and non-color encodings for exports.
Omar Haddad: I'll open a tiny frontend PR with the swatch/pill/heatmap changes + a11y numbers. Will include before/after PPT export screenshots and a feature-flag for patterned exports. ETA tomorrow AM PST.
Vi Tran: please tag @design for sign-off and note embeddables inherit vars. Also add a short console copy tweak: "High-contrast exports (PDF/PPT)" with a tooltip describing the pattern fallback.
Hannah Lee: nice. once PR lands we'll validate with QA's printer agent. thanks team :raised_hands:
